_readme: URL map for scripts/results.py: where the VEC's public results pages are. Each profile lists the page address patterns;
{base} is the profile's base, {slug} the district or region name lower-cased and hyphenated as the VEC writes it
(e.g. 'albert-park', 'eastern-victoria'). 'overrides' maps a district or region id to a full URL when one page doesn't
follow the pattern. The 2026 profile's base is null until the VEC publishes its 2026 results pages (expected after
nominations close on 9 Nov; election-night trial on 25 Nov): fill in 'base' (and any changed pattern) from the VEC's
'2026 State election results' page, then run 'python scripts/results.py --check-urls' to confirm every page answers.
The 2022 profile points at the final 2022 pages and is used to test the parser ('--profile 2022 --data-dir <copy>').
